title: Polaris @ Woodlands
subtitle: Unit C — 3,347 sqft
description:
One of 3 consecutive corner B1 industrial units available for rent at Polaris @ Woodlands. Units are currently in use — 3 for own use, 1 already tenanted. Owner is open to renting or selling towards year-end, and is open to a sale-and-leaseback arrangement at a higher sale price.

Unit is renovated and equipped with 3-phase 100A power (upgraded direct with developer) and 40-footer container access.
highlights: 3 consecutive corner units available for rent
